E01 · Argentina forced-choice immigrant conjoint experiment

Class 1 · A distinct national respondent sample received newly randomized paired applicant profiles. It is primary because the article's central hypotheses and country-specific results rely on this manipulation.

Experiment design: factorial experiment; conjoint experiment; survey experiment

Design map

Target population

National population of Argentina; described as a nationally representative national sample.
nationally representative samples in 22 democraciesPDF page 2 · Introduction

The article characterizes the country samples as nationally representative.

Eligibility criteria

NR

Recruitment procedure

Lucid Marketplace online survey; quota sampling on age, gender, and education; national language/script, with added French in Canada, Tagalog in the Philippines, and Zulu in South Africa.
via Lucid MarketplacePDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Surveys were administered through Lucid with quotas for age, gender, and education and in national languages.

Field dates and setting

Late February to early March 2022; online survey in respondents' country.
via Lucid MarketplacePDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Surveys were administered through Lucid with quotas for age, gender, and education and in national languages.

Number recruited and analyzed

NR for this country. Pooled across 22 countries, 46,549 completed and passed a two-part attention check.
completed the survey and passed a two-part attention checkPDF page 5 · Experimental Design

The reported total is restricted to completers who passed an attention check.

Experimental arms or randomized attributes

Six paired-profile tasks. Attributes/levels: age 21/38/62; gender female/male; residence 15/10/5 years; language fluent/limited/none; occupation doctor/teacher/accountant/farmer/cleaner/unemployed; origin countries China, United Kingdom, Japan, Ireland, mapped to rival/non-rival and perceived similar/dissimilar race/culture.
age, education, language competence, and profession, as well as length of residencyPDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Exact treatment and comparator

Two hypothetical applicants with randomized attributes are compared; respondent chooses which receives permanent residence.
six successive choices between paired immigrantsPDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Binary applicant selection for permanent residence in each of six successive tasks, during the late-February/early-March 2022 survey; explicit numeric coding and primary/secondary status NR.
probability that an immigrant with certain attributes will be chosenPDF page 8 · Results

six successive choices between paired immigrantsPDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Class 1 · A distinct national respondent sample received newly randomized paired applicant profiles. It is primary because the article's central hypotheses and country-specific results rely on this manipulation.

NR

Lucid Marketplace online survey; quota sampling on age, gender, and education; national language/script, with added French in Canada, Tagalog in the Philippines, and Zulu in South Africa.

Six paired-profile tasks. Lucid Marketplace online survey; quota sampling on age, gender, and education; national language/script, with added French in Canada, Tagalog in the Philippines, and Zulu in South Africa.
via Lucid MarketplacePDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Field dates and setting

Late February to early March 2022; online survey in respondents' country.
via Lucid MarketplacePDF page 5 · Experimental Design

Number recruited and analyzed

NR for this country. Pooled across 22 countries, 46,549 completed and passed a two-part attention check.
completed the survey and passed a two-part attention checkPDF page 5 · Experimental Design

The reported total is restricted to completers who passed an attention check.

Experimental arms or randomized attributes

Six paired-profile tasks. Attributes/levels: age 21/38/62; gender female/male; residence 15/10/5 years; language fluent/limited/none; occupation doctor/teacher/accountant/farmer/cleaner/unemployed; origin countries China, Russia, Taiwan, Ukraine, mapped to rival/non-rival and perceived similar/dissimilar race/culture.
